verdict.rationale: Notion's marketing claims Q&A with citations and 24/7 agents that could generate insights from workspace data, suggesting an applicable AI feature. However, the evidence pack offers only marketing taglines with no technical documentation of how insights/suggestions are generated or independent/hands-on corroboration that these AI features actually surface useful data-driven insights. Missing for 10: detailed docs on Notion AI's insight-generation capability, concrete examples of AI suggestions from workspace data, and independent user validation of quality/accuracy.
